pure-announcement.rationale: It is a project README with setup instructions and an architecture diagram, not a launch, release or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts touches LLM-driven trading backtests; they cover code graphs, OSV, retrieval evals and alerting.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims are trivially checkable by running the open-source repo the note points at.

durability.rationale: The note is almost entirely quick-start mechanics — make targets, .env key switching between Azure OpenAI and Gemini, Windows caveats — and the one lasting idea (an LLM as the decision engine inside a backtest loop) exists only as an unexplained flowchart.

actionability.rationale: Its only actions are product-only steps for this specific repo (make install, cp .env, make run); it offers no design guidance a reader could apply to their own trading or backtesting system.

atomicity.rationale: It carries a single idea — an LLM-driven stock backtesting system combining technical analysis and risk management — which fits in one paragraph.
